items.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: And Michael Moore I love playing with too.

ctx.x: Definitely. Of course I love playing with drums too, because every drummer makes me play a slightly different way and again, like Jake Hanna of course has been one of my great friends for years, and has helped me a lot. And I love playing with him because he is absolutely committed to the music. He’s never compromising, always completely into it, and just great to play with. And Michael Moore I love playing with too. There’s a bunch of them.
Yeah. There are so many great musicians out there, and I wonder sometimes, like how does everybody find work?
